# Notice of Company Dissolution in India [...] This notice from the Registrar of Companies in Delhi announces that 22864 companies listed in an attachment have been struck off from the register of companies and dissolved pursuant to the Companies Act of 2013. The notice provides background information on the legal basis for the dissolution under section 248(5) of the Act and references previous notices issued on the matter on specified dates requiring these companies to submit documents or get dissolved.
